:::{#exr-bias-exprs}
#### Bias in terms of the expectation

Write the [bias](#def-bias) $\bias{\hparam}$ of an estimator $\hparam$
in terms of its expected value $\E{\hparam}$ and the estimand $\param$.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-bias-exprs}

$$
\begin{aligned}
\bias{\hparam}
&\eqdef \E{\erf{\hparam}}
&& \text{(definition of bias)}\\
&= \E{\hparam - \param}
&& \text{(definition of estimation error)}\\
&= \E{\hparam} - \E{\param}
&& \text{(linearity of expectation)}\\
&= \E{\hparam} - \param
&& \text{($\param$ is a constant)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
